facts.statement: India macro (Oct-Dec 2025 bulletin): real GDP growth Q2 FY26 was 8.2% (Q1: 7.8%); India's GDP of USD 4.18 trillion surpassed Japan to become the 4th largest economy; CAD moderated to 1.3% of GDP in Q2 FY26; headline CPI was 1.33% in December 2025; forex reserves were USD 696.61 billion on 26 December 2025; inward remittances grew 10.7% YoY in Q2 FY26.
facts.detail: Jul-Sep 2025 bulletin: RBI projected 7% real GDP growth for Q2 FY26; CAD narrowed to 0.2% of GDP in Q1 FY26; remittances USD 35.3 billion in Q1; core inflation 4.6% in September 2025; forex reserves USD 697.8 billion on 10 October 2025 with 11.3 months import cover.

facts.statement: Current affairs Jan-2026: Vande Bharat Sleeper (Guwahati-Howrah); DRDO 68th Foundation Day (1 January; established 1958); CSIR-NPL 80th Foundation Day (5 January); Surat became the first 70-lakh-population slum-free city; an Indian AI Research Organisation was announced at GIFT City; Suryastra rocket launcher (NIBE + Elbit Systems); K-4 SLBM tested from INS Arighaat (range 3,500 km); the Army declared 2026 the 'Year of Networking & Data Centricity'.

Economy current affairs (Dec-2025/Jan-2026): GST collection December 2025 was Rs 1.75 lakh crore (+6.1% YoY); GDP FY26 first advance estimate was 7.4% real growth; UPI recorded 21.63 billion transactions (+29% YoY) worth Rs 30.34 trillion in December 2025; fiscal deficit to November 2025 was Rs 9.77 lakh crore (62.3% of budget estimates); India-EFTA TEPA carries a USD 100 billion investment ambition and 1 million jobs target; the PPP pipeline had 852 projects worth Rs 17 lakh crore.

Persons and miscellaneous (Jan-2026): Warren Buffett stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway CEO with Greg Abel succeeding; Kaamya Karthikeyan (18) became the youngest Indian to ski to the South Pole; Assam became the first state to constitute the 8th Pay Commission; BIS concessions are 80% for micro, 50% for small and 20% for medium enterprises.

India scale indicators: 4th largest economy by nominal GDP; 5th largest by several earlier rankings; exports USD 776 billion FY23; FDI inflow USD 81.04 billion FY25 (USD 84.8 billion FY22); remittances USD 135 billion FY25; 1.3 billion Aadhaar holders; 1.2 billion mobile users with 750 million smartphones; mutual-fund AUM expected to reach USD 1.47 trillion by 2025; UPI processed 117 billion+ transactions in CY2023; FinTech adoption rate 87% (globally highest); GCCs in India 1,580 in 2023 expected to exceed 1,900 by 2025; renewable capacity 180.79 GW (December 2023) with a 500 GW target by 2030 and net-zero by 2070; 1.61 lakh startups as of 31 January 2025.
facts.source_ref: India at a glance; FM brochure

facts.statement: Market context 2024: FPI investment approximately USD 20 billion in CY2024; mutual-fund AUM grew 6x in a decade to about USD 0.8 trillion by December 2024; FPI debt investment doubled to USD 18 billion in CY2024 (from USD 7 billion) driven by JP Morgan GBI inclusion in June 2024; domestic AIF industry crossed 1,400 funds with about USD 146 billion; T+0 settlement expanded to the top 500 scrips from 1 May 2025; T+1 sale-proceeds efficiency gains estimated at USD 235 million per year; granular FPI disclosure threshold proposed to rise from about USD 3 billion to USD 6 billion.

December-2023 GIFT IFSC snapshot (PwC): 580+ registered entities; 23 banks; banking assets USD 51.98 billion; derivative transactions USD 148 billion; 2 stock exchanges with turnover USD 66.73 billion; cumulative debt listings USD 52.97 billion (green/ESG USD 10.43 billion); 72 broker-dealers; 95 AIFs with commitments USD 7.08 billion; 128 aviation assets leased; 7 ship-leasing entities; 29 insurance offices/intermediaries; 47 FinTech entities.

India's FinTech market is expected to reach INR 6.2 trillion by 2025 with 2,100+ FinTechs and 887 active lending apps; IOSCO is headquartered in Madrid and its membership covers over 95% of the world's securities markets.

The Global Securities Markets Conclave 2.0 (26-27 February 2026), themed 'Global Capital Flows: Navigating Cross-Border Investments in the Age of AI', drew 500+ participants; MoUs were signed between the Taiwan Stock Exchange and India INX/NSE IFSC, AFRINEX (Mauritius) and India INX, the Colombo Stock Exchange and NSE IFSC, and a Cyprus Stock Exchange dual-listing arrangement with NSE IX; the first KYC Registration Agency was operationalised, IFSCA-ICSI certification programs were launched, and Project ACE (Accelerating Commodity Trading Ecosystem) was presented.
